title: SCP-055
description: Replaces all letters, numbers, and symbols with block textures for Minecraft 1.20.1. Perfect for SCP and puzzle maps.
body:
# 方块字体 / Block Font

**Minecraft 1.20.1 Resource Pack**

---

## 中文介绍

### 功能说明

本材质包通过替换原版游戏的字体贴图(`assets/minecraft/textures/font/`),将游戏中所有可见的 **英文字母(A–Z, a–z)、数字(0–9)以及常用符号** 全部转换为 **方块 (Block)** 样式。

### 特色

- **完全替换**:覆盖 `ascii.png`、`ascii_sga.png`、`unicode_page_00.png`、`unicode_page_01.png` 等核心字体文件
- **沉浸式体验**:聊天栏、物品名称、告示牌、书与笔、命令方块…… 所有文字都将以方块形式呈现
- **玩法扩展**:非常适合用于:
  - 密室逃脱 / 解谜地图
  - SCP 主题冒险
  - 视觉解谜与符号破译
  - 整蛊 / 搞笑生存
- **纯客户端**:无需安装任何模组,放入 `resourcepacks` 文件夹即可启用
- **兼容性好**:基于 1.20.1 资源包格式,可与大多数原版及模组材质包共存

### 安装方法

1. 将本资源包文件放入 `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` 目录
2. 在游戏选项 → 资源包中选择并启用
3. 进入世界,所有文字即刻变成方块!

> ⚠️ **注意**:由于文字被替换为方块,游戏内信息阅读将变得困难,请根据玩法需要合理使用。

---

## English Description

### Overview

This resource pack replaces the vanilla font textures in `assets/minecraft/textures/font/`, transforming **all English letters (A–Z, a–z), numbers (0–9), and common symbols** into **block-style** characters throughout the game.

### Features

- **Complete Override**: Replaces core font files including `ascii.png`, `ascii_sga.png`, `unicode_page_00.png`, and `unicode_page_01.png`
- **Full Immersion**: Chat, item names, signs, books & quills, command blocks — every text becomes blocks
- **Perfect For**:
  - Escape rooms / puzzle maps
  - SCP-themed adventures
  - Visual decoding & symbol puzzles
  - Pranks & chaotic survival challenges
- **Client-side Only**: No mods required — just drop it into `resourcepacks` and play
- **Highly Compatible**: Built on the 1.20.1 resource pack format, works alongside most vanilla and modded texture packs

### Installation

1. Place the `.zip` into your `.minecraft/resourcepacks/` folder
2. Enable it in **Options → Resource Packs**
3. Launch a world — all text is now blocks!

> ⚠️ **Note**: Since all readable text becomes blocks, in-game information will be unreadable. Use intentionally for the best experience.

---
